Consider the distribution of a solute X between two immiscible solvents: water and ether.
X(aq) $\rightleftharpoons$ X(ether)
The equilibrium constant, $K_c$, is 0.15 at $25 \text{ °C}$.
$50 \text{ cm}^3$ of a solution of X in ether at $25 \text{ °C}$ contains $21.5 \text{ g}$ of X. $100 \text{ cm}^3$ of water is added, shaken with the ether solution and allowed to reach equilibrium at $25 \text{ °C}$.
What is the maximum mass of X that can be transferred into the aqueous layer?
